title: Wire goal runtime into REPL command contexts
objective: Make /goal work in TUI and screen-reader command paths by connecting commands.Context to session-backed Goal state.
context: The command is now registered, but it needs a runtime adapter that reads and writes the current session's Goal metadata.
This task is intentionally separate because repl_tui.go is a large shared file.

source_evidence.note: TUI builds command registry and command context.
Slash command dispatch executes cmd.Execute(buildCmdCtx(), args).
Screen-reader mode has a separate command path.

include: Attach it to commands.Context in TUI and screen-reader paths.
Ensure /goal changes are saved via existing session metadata repository.
Refresh local runtime state after command execution.
exclude: No new UI status bar rendering.

implementation_steps: Find buildCmdCtx or equivalent command context creation.
Implement a tiny adapter around current session ID and repo SaveMeta/GetMeta.
Attach the adapter in both REPL surfaces.
Run focused command and session tests.
deliverables: Interactive command paths can read and write session Goal metadata.
acceptance_criteria: /goal works from the TUI command path.
Screen-reader command mode compiles and uses the same behavior.
No unrelated TUI code is refactored.
risks: repl_tui.go is likely to be dirty or conflict-prone.
dispatch_prompt: Wire the /goal command runtime into TUI and screen-reader command contexts. Use session metadata as the backing store and keep edits minimal around command context creation.
notes_for_assignee: If repl_tui.go has unrelated dirty changes, read carefully and avoid overwriting them.
